title: KiCad Plugin Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution   Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of KiCad. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of plugin packages. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user.
addtionnal_details:
KiCad has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://gitlab.com/kicad/code/kicad/-/commit/e60c1fc0838339200742cc1ac9fcc1302cbedec5
